entity_facts.synonyms_note: RHS gives the first two; E-Flora BC lists 17 synonyms (mostly subspecies/variety combinations) and USDA PLANTS lists ARAD3, ARUVA etc.; only a representative subset is kept here
entity_facts.common_name_note: RHS lists some 25 further British folk names (barren myrtle, bear's grape, crowberry, ground holly…); E-Flora: kinnikinnick, common bearberry, mealberry, sandberry; USDA: kinnikinnick
entity_facts.botanical_growth_form: prostrate, mat-forming evergreen shrub with trailing stems rooting at the nodes (E-Flora, OSU, MOBOT, USDA)
entity_facts.design_role: groundcover (RHS, MOBOT, OSU all list ground cover as the primary use)
entity_facts.kpu_plant_type_note: botanical form is a prostrate broadleaf evergreen shrub (MOBOT type 'Broadleaf evergreen'; OSU 'Broadleaf'; USDA shrub/subshrub with leaf retention). 'Ground cover' is also a KPU plant type but describes the design role; the project keeps the two apart, so Broadleaf evergreen is proposed as the plant type and Ground cover as a landscape_use
entity_facts.origin: circumboreal — northern North America (Alaska to Newfoundland, south to northern California, New Mexico, Virginia), Europe and Asia; native to BC (E-Flora Yellow list, S5) and to Canada/US (USDA)
entity_facts.companions_note: no source names a specific companion species; RHS 'Vancouver Jade' suggests underplanting roses and shrubs and MOBOT suggests growing it around shrubs, both generic
